annotations.title: Compare federal student loan repayment plans

description: Estimates each federal repayment plan on the borrower's own numbers (RAP, IBR, 10-year Standard, Tiered Standard under the 2026 rules): first monthly payment, total paid, years to payoff or forgiveness, amount forgiven, which plans are open given loan dates, the cheapest plan, PSLF timing for government or 501(c)(3) workers, and Parent PLUS options. Same math as the studentloan.help calculator. Estimates only.

agi.description: Borrower's adjusted gross income in dollars per year.

dependents.description: Dependents claimed; RAP subtracts $50 a month for each.

employer.description: for_profit (or self-employed), government, nonprofit_501c3 or nonprofit_other. Government and 501(c)(3) add the PSLF projection.

filing_status.description: single (or head of household), married_joint or married_separate.

full_time.description: Works at least 30 hours a week for a qualifying employer (needed for PSLF).

household_size.description: Household size (borrower, spouse, dependents); sets the poverty line for IBR.

income_growth_pct.description: Assumed yearly income growth in percent (calculator default 3).

loan_dates.description: owed_before_2014_07_01 (IBR at 15%), first_loan_2014_to_2026 (IBR at 10%), or loan_on_or_after_2026_07_01 (only RAP and Tiered Standard).

loans.description: Each loan: type, balance in dollars and annual interest rate in percent, e.g. [{"type":"direct","balance":38000,"rate_pct":6.39}]. Direct includes Grad PLUS and Direct Consolidation loans.

rate_pct.description: Annual interest rate in percent, e.g. 6.39.

type.description: direct, ffel (FFEL or Perkins), parent_plus (or a consolidation of one), or private.

poverty_growth_pct.description: Assumed yearly poverty guideline growth in percent (calculator default 2.5).

pslf_payments_made.description: PSLF qualifying payments already counted, 0 to 120.

region.description: Poverty guideline region: contiguous_48_or_dc, alaska or hawaii.

spouse_agi.description: Spouse's AGI in dollars; counted only when married_joint.

spouse_federal_loan_balance.description: Spouse's federal loan balance; prorates the payment when married_joint.

name: compare_repayment_plans
title: Compare federal student loan repayment plans
